su: [ anukaraṇasaddā ] (pu) CL=7 See - Sūsū. See also - Sukara.
[ su + a + ti. Bhūvādi. ၐru-saṃ. Sua-prā ] (dhātu) CL=7 (1) Going. (2) Dripping. (3) Encouragement or motivation.
[ su + ṇu (ṇā) + ti. Svādi giuṇaḥ. ] (dhātu) CL=7 (1) Hearing. (2) Listening. (3) Affliction. (4) Bathing.
[ svada-saṃ ] (bya) CL=7 (1) The expletive particle (just for a smooth sentence or speech). (2) Quickly. (3) Doubt (Saṃsayattha).

[ su + u (ḍu). Thoma, kotthubha. Sobhanatthe sukhatthe ca, suṭṭhusammā-ratthesu ca. Samiddhiyādīsu ceva, susaddo sampavattati. Nīti, sutta. 368-nhā. Rū. 126-nhā. Su-saṃ, prā. ] (bya) CL=7 (1) Graceful and good. (sobhana, sādhu). (2) Comfortable and Easily done (sukha, sukara). (3) (A) Well and right (suṭṭhu, sammā). (B) Better than or more right (suṭṭhutara). (4) Achievement (samiddhi). (5) Beautiful (sundara). (6) Everything (sabbathā, sabbaso). (7) Equality (sama). (8) Abundance or excessive (atisaya). (9) Clean and pure (parisuddha, visuddha). (10) Sweet or pleasant (sumadhura). (11) Nibbāna.
[ anukaraṇa = atuliuka၍ pruso saddā, raṃkhā၌ susu, hu 2- pudarhisañña. ] (bya) CL=7 The sound of 'shu, shu shu'.
